Independent selected actual15 chain: conditional join contract
============================================================
This check-only join distinguishes mathematical implications, full semantic
replay, and independent receipt/geometry checks. It imports no score evaluator
or inherited driver and performs no new Fourier integration or count-leaf
arithmetic. Missing final inputs are listed as pending; incomplete execution
is never promoted to a completed theorem. It writes a new named snapshot
only and never modifies its selected inputs.

Retained analytic hypothesis A
------------------------------
A comprises the unrestricted iid extremal/attainment reduction (with both
strict/closed CDF branches and reflection), the same-law contact inequality
and its Gaussian support reduction, the signed moment/LOW/physical-gap
resource inequalities used by the INITIAL and resource engine, and the
physical D sharp count reduction. In particular these must apply to an
unrestricted attained positive closed maximizing witness selected by a
contrary sharp15 assumption; restriction to a moment band is a property of
that witness and cannot replace unrestricted extremality. A is retained
from the project's analytic framework and is not independently established
in full by this readback. Published Prawitz smoothing and Shevtsova tail
theorems, the compatible cosine profile certificate, and the supported eta
lemma are separate analytic inputs to the Fourier receipts. This program
does not turn their source hashes or fresh arithmetic into analytic proofs.

Exact acyclic implications
-------------------------
1. The independently integrated auxiliary theorem gives C14<21/50 for ALL
   standardized iid marginals and all thresholds, without a support or
   contact assumption. If a sharp15 contrary witness P exists with
   rho<=33/25, then C15(P)>=CE>4097/10000 and its same-law contact allowance
   satisfies 15(C14(P)-C15(P))_+ <=15*(21/50-4097/10000).
2. The coarse full-ray support certificate at actual15 and rho<=33/25
   therefore gives |X|<=3 for this very witness. Both support rays and all
   real raw thresholds are included; no own-score cap is used here.
3. The supported actual14/15 Fourier theorem now applies to the SAME P at
   both indices. On B0=[1,11/10] its all-threshold cap is417/1000; on
   BN=[11/10,23/20] it is827/2000. The actual14 estimate gives contact
   allowances q=219/2000 and57/1000 respectively. The actual15 estimate is
   a valid own-score upper bound for this same maximizing witness. There
   is no appeal to monotonicity in n and no comparison of different
   sample-size maximizing laws.
4. The selected refined support proof, using those allowances and the
   same signed beta interval, acquires radius23/10 or12/5. Its proof covers
   both complete rays uniformly in the threshold. These radii already
   imply radius3 BEFORE use of compensated HIGH, so no circular support
   argument is introduced by that improved Fourier remainder bound.
5. The selected initial15_compensated_v1 starts raw=D=None. It performs
   eight feedback stages and a ninth export cover; each is the complete
   12*12*6*3 signed cover of the same law, with all100 closed p panels.
   Its independent semantic replay recomputes support, every cover and
   every outward update. No rejected moment-defect seed is imported.
   Final physical D<sqrt(10)-1 supplies the central gap used in resources.
6. The refreshed resource family reconstructs every original p panel from
   that export and preserves the same p, moment, sign and sample-size
   coordinates. Selected support refinements only shrink support. The
   compensated HIGH minimum is an entire normalized integral, with both
   characteristic and comparator tails; support<=3 and the rho band hold
   before every call. Each of100 rows is freshly semantically replayed.
   A failed criterion means unresolved. An empty INITIAL row, a negative
   budget, or another proved necessary-condition contradiction is an
   exclusion only at the exact source/replay scope recorded for that row.
7. For each remaining acquired row, the outward count contract is checked
   independently. Original Lambda is retained in the affine triangle and
   root, while acquired_lambda_upper is the redundant same cap. Positive
   physical endpoint floors, signed beta and physical mean refer to this
   same law. Both signed quadratic envelopes dominate on their complete
   H intervals. Mathematical n15 applicability and the d<1/2 triangle proof
   are separately in audit/count15_range_v1/REVIEW.txt.
8. All16 nearest-count roots are reconstructed. Every binary split includes
   both closed children, every leaf box is reconstructed from the original
   root, and every score leaf is strictly below the unchanged rational
   CE lower bound. This readback independently checks forest geometry and
   aggregate arithmetic; the native fresh acceptor separately recomputes
   all leaf inequalities. All100 original p panels must be accounted for,
   including shared faces and explicit failed/pending rows.
9. For the remaining rho band [23/20,33/25], supported actual15 Fourier
   gives score<4097/10000<CE using the already acquired coarse radius3.
   For rho>=33/25 the unrestricted high-rho actual15 theorem gives the same
   strict bound without support. These closed bands cover every rho>=1
   together with B0/BN. Both CDF error signs are supplied by the global
   Fourier theorem or by reflecting the WHOLE maximizing marginal in A.

What a completed readback means
------------------------------
If all selected receipts exist, all exact checks pass, and all low-rho
panels are closed, the result is a CONDITIONAL actual15 sharp exclusion
under A and the explicitly listed Fourier analytic inputs. It is not by
itself a cutoff15 theorem: literal16..19 and the retained20+ continuation
remain separate edges. Even a completed conditional actual15 join leaves
global_bound_proved and cutoff15_proved false in its output. A missing
count forest, failed leaf, absent Fourier replay/readback, or unaccounted
panel keeps conditional_actual15_closed false and is listed by exact path.

Independent checks versus retained execution
-------------------------------------------
The check uses only standard Python integer/Fraction arithmetic, its own
strict JSON parser and source-graph merge. It recomputes the Machin/square
root CE enclosure independently, all signed quadratic interface minima,
original p coverage, Fourier row normalization and closed strip seams,
and count-tree geometry/strict stored score comparisons. It verifies full
construction/replay identity (excluding timing only), all source hashes
and native capture identities. This is stronger than hash agreement but
does not duplicate the integration or leaf arithmetic implementations.
Negative controls corrupt scope, original Lambda, panel/strip coverage,
counts, closed splits, leaf boxes and scores in disposable in-memory copies.
Source-binding rejects inherited missing inputs or changed selected files.

The current selected source epochs are:
 analytic/support15_19_replay_v1,
 analytic/initial15_compensated_v1 and initial15_compensated_replay_v1,
 analytic/resource15_refreshed_v1,
 analytic/count15_v1,
 fourier/auxiliary14_19_v1 and auxiliary14_19_readback_v1,
 fourier/supported14_19_v1 and supported14_19_readback_v1,
 fourier/highrho14_19_v1 and highrho14_19_readback_v1,
 root/cancellation_high_v1 and fourier/cancellation_high_readback_v1.
